description: Somos estudiantes de Ing. en Tecnologías de la Información, buscando demostrar sus conocimientos y habilidades de desarrollo Web aprendido en la UTN.
summary: We developed an interactive and easy to use web interface that helps the general public access and filter the images captured by the SPHEREx mission, our take on the challenge was making the web page easy to navigate as well as making it easy to view the different wavelenghts and types of data obtained from NASA.
details:
CepheusLive lets you select or input coordenates of a patch of sky and gives you a series of images captured by the satellite in the form of a GIF that can be downloaded, as well as letting you play with the different wavelenghts and showing an alert given that an anomaly is detected in the images.

This project is set to make all kinds of people interested in learning more about the SPHEREx mission, whether they are in their early stages of education or grown adults. Python is the backbone of this web tool, with the help of JavaScript, CSS and HTML to guarantee that the page works and is displayed properly, different NASA sources were used to gather and display information and images inside of the page.

Creativity can flow with this web tool using the different options integrated into the search and filtering system, giving you multiple ways to display the images and also compare them to different dates.

Simply enter the page and select one of the preset coordinates, or if you prefer, try typing one in yourself, set the parameters for the images —how the images will be displayed— choose from the different bands of near-infrared light, and you will see a GIF of the images stitched together that you can download directly to your computer!
